product: Sharing foreign schemas and tables with OpenSharing is now generally available
tagline: Sharing and reading foreign schemas and foreign tables with OpenSharing is now generally available.
what_it_does: Sharing and reading foreign schemas and foreign tables with OpenSharing is now generally available. Providers can share foreign schemas and tables federated from external data sources using Lakehouse Federation, without copying data into Databricks. Sharing foreign schemas and tables materializes data on the provider's side, which incurs compute and storage costs.
